lines: 上一章，我们把训练写成了一个目标：让损失尽量小。
In the last chapter, training became an objective: make the loss as small as possible.
现在换个看法：参数是地形上的位置，损失是海拔。
Now picture the parameters as a position on a landscape, and the loss as altitude.
训练，就是在这片看不见的地形里，找到最低的谷底。
Training means finding the lowest valley in terrain you cannot see.
你看不见地图，只能感到脚下这一点的坡度。
You have no map. You can only feel the slope under your feet.
那就朝最陡的下坡方向迈一步，再感受，再迈。
So take a step downhill, feel again, and take another.
这个笨办法叫梯度下降，是整门课发动机的点火钥匙。
This crude method is gradient descent, the ignition key of the whole engine.
这一章只回答两件事：往哪走，以及怎么走得动。
This chapter answers two things: which way to go, and how to keep moving.
先把「坡度」变成一个可以算的东西。
First, turn "slope" into something we can compute.
损失对每个参数的偏导数，排成一个向量，叫梯度。
The partial derivative of the loss for each parameter, stacked into a vector, is the gradient.
偏导数的意思：只让这一个参数动一点点，损失变化多快。
A partial derivative asks: if only this parameter moves a little, how fast does the loss change?
梯度指向上升最快的方向，所以下山要取它的负号。
The gradient points uphill. To go down, we take its negative.
如果把它画成一个箭头，方向是最陡的上坡，长度是坡度有多陡。
Drawn as an arrow, it points steepest uphill, and its length says how steep.
更新规则只有一行：θ 减去 η 乘以梯度。
The update rule is one line: theta minus eta times the gradient.
θ 是参数，η 是学习率，梯度是这一点的坡度。
Theta is the parameter, eta is the learning rate, the gradient is the local slope.
注意，这是一阶信息：它只告诉你方向，不告诉你谷底有多远。
Note this is first-order information: it gives direction, not the distance to the valley.
所以沿着它走，每一步都得重新量一次坡度。
So every step, you have to measure the slope again.
这就是为什么，后面还需要学习率和更好的优化器。
That is why we still need a learning rate, and better optimizers.
公式里唯一要人亲手选的数，是学习率 η。
The only number a human must pick in that formula is the learning rate, eta.
它决定每一步迈多大，也决定训练能不能收敛。
It sets the step size, and decides whether training converges at all.
步子太小，下山太慢，走一万步还在半山腰。
Too small: the descent crawls, and after ten thousand steps you are still halfway up.
步子太大，一步跨过谷底，在对岸来回横跳。
Too large: you leap across the valley and bounce between the two sides.
再大一点，甚至会越跳越高，这叫发散。
Larger still, and each bounce grows: that is divergence.
这个两难，在数值分析里叫稳定性与收敛速度的权衡。
Numerical analysis calls this the stability versus convergence-speed trade-off.
它和用欧拉法解微分方程时选步长，是同一个问题。
It is the same problem as choosing a step size for the Euler method.
常见做法是先取一个能走动的值，再随着训练慢慢减小。
A common recipe: start with a value that moves, then shrink it during training.
学习率不是越小越安全，它是整场训练最敏感的旋钮。
A smaller learning rate is not automatically safer. It is the most sensitive knob in training.
但真正的麻烦是：梯度要对整个训练集求平均。
But the real trouble is that the gradient averages over the whole training set.
几百万条样本，每条都要前向一次，算不起。
Millions of examples, each needing a forward pass: that is unaffordable.
于是每次只抽一小批，比如 32 条，用这一批当估计。
So we sample a small batch, say thirty-two, and use its gradient as an estimate.
批量越小，噪声越大；越大，越接近全量梯度。
A smaller batch means more noise; a larger batch approaches the full gradient.
这叫随机梯度下降，随机指的是抽样带来的噪声。
This is stochastic gradient descent. "Stochastic" refers to the noise from sampling.
噪声看着是缺点，其实是优点。
The noise looks like a defect. It is actually a feature.
它帮你跳出浅坑，也自带正则化，不让你死记每一条样本。
It helps you escape shallow pits, and it regularizes, so you cannot memorize every example.
生物学里早有原型：大肠杆菌的趋化性。
Biology got there first: the chemotaxis of E. coli.
它没有地图，只检测周围营养浓度在升还是在降。
It has no map. It only senses whether nutrient concentration is rising or falling.
浓度上升就少翻滚、继续直游；下降就多翻滚、换个方向。
Rising: tumble less, keep swimming straight. Falling: tumble more, pick a new direction.
一句话：SGD 的噪声，就是细菌的翻滚。
In one line: the noise in SGD is the bacterium's tumble.
接下来是最可怕的问题：几十亿个参数，导数怎么算。
Now the frightening question: with billions of parameters, how do we get the derivatives?
最笨的办法叫数值微分：把参数加一点点，看损失变多少。
The dumb way is numerical differentiation: nudge a parameter, see how the loss moves.
每个参数都要重跑一次前向，参数一多，计算量直接爆炸。
That reruns a forward pass per parameter, and the cost explodes.
所以数值微分是逐个去试，反向传播是一次算清。
Numerical differentiation tries each parameter; backprop settles all of them at once.
反向传播只做两次遍历：一次前向，一次反向。
Backpropagation does two passes: one forward, one backward.
就能拿到所有参数的梯度，代价和一次前向同一个量级。
It gets every gradient at a cost on the order of a single forward pass.
它靠两件事：链式法则，和动态规划。
It relies on two things: the chain rule, and dynamic programming.
链式法则说，把责任一层一层往回乘。
The chain rule says: pass the blame backward, multiplying at each layer.
网络是 x 到 h，到 ŷ，再到损失 L。
The network is x to h, to y-hat, to the loss L.
L 对 x 的导数，就是三段局部导数的乘积。
The derivative of L with respect to x is the product of three local derivatives.
中间那一项会被复用：缓存一次，每个节点只做局部乘法。
The middle term gets reused: cache it once, and each node does only a local multiply.
这就是动态规划：不重复计算已经算过的子问题。
That is dynamic programming: never recompute a subproblem you already solved.
前向存下中间结果，反向把「你对损失的贡献」逐层传回去。
Store intermediates going forward; coming back, pass each node's contribution to the loss.
手算一个例子。ŷ 等于 wx 加 b，损失是预测减目标的平方。
Let's do one by hand. y-hat equals wx plus b; the loss is the squared error.
Take x equals three, w equals two, b equals one, target y equals ten.
前向：ŷ=7，误差 −3，损失 9。
Forward: y-hat is seven, the error is minus three, the loss is nine.
反向：损失对 ŷ 的导数是 2 倍误差，等于 −6。
Backward: the derivative of the loss with respect to y-hat is twice the error, minus six.
对 w 是 −6 乘 3，等于 −18；对 b 是 −6 乘 1，等于 −6。
For w: minus six times three, minus eighteen. For b: minus six times one, minus six.
取学习率 0.1：w 变 3.8，b 变 1.6。
With a learning rate of 0.1, w becomes 3.8 and b becomes 1.6.
新预测是 13，目标是 10，过头了。
The new prediction is thirteen. The target is ten. We overshot.
With 0.02: w is 2.36, b is 1.12, and the prediction is 8.2.
梯度只告诉你方向，学习率决定你信它多少。
The gradient gives the direction; the learning rate decides how much you trust it.
这里只有一次乘法，但把它叠一千层，就是深度学习。
One multiply here. Stack a thousand of these, and you have deep learning.

scenes.zh: 同一个算法的四个名字
lines: 反向传播不是深度学习独有的发明。
Backpropagation is not a deep-learning invention.
同一个算法，在至少四个学科里被独立发现过。
The same algorithm was discovered independently in at least four fields.
最优控制里叫伴随法，算控制量对目标的影响。
Optimal control calls it the adjoint method: how a control affects the objective.
气象学里叫 4D-Var，用观测反推大气的初始场。
Meteorology calls it 4D-Var: infer the atmosphere's initial state from observations.
自动微分里叫反向模式，PyTorch 的 Autograd 就是它。
Automatic differentiation calls it reverse mode. PyTorch's Autograd is exactly this.
经济学里叫影子价格：约束松一格，最优目标改善多少。
Economics calls it a shadow price: relax a constraint by one unit, how much does the objective gain?
名字不同，内核相同：一次反向遍历，换所有输入的梯度。
Different names, same kernel: one backward sweep buys the gradient for every input.
数学上，它们都在算同一件事：输出对每个输入的敏感度。
Mathematically, all of them compute the same thing: the output's sensitivity to each input.
所以 Autograd 并不「懂」神经网络，它只会反向的链式法则。
So Autograd does not "understand" neural networks. It only runs the chain rule in reverse.
理论上反向传播能训练任意深度，实践中一深就训不动。
In theory backprop trains any depth. In practice, deep networks would not train.
四个工程发明解决了这件事，它们是现代大模型的地基。
Four engineering inventions fixed that. They are the foundation of modern LLMs.
2014 年的 Adam：给每个参数维护梯度均值和平方均值。
Adam, 2014: keep a running mean and a running mean of squared gradients per parameter.
梯度大的参数自动小步走，梯度小的自动大步走。
Large gradients take small steps; small gradients take large steps, automatically.
同年的 Dropout：训练时随机丢掉一部分神经元。
Dropout, same year: randomly drop some neurons during training.
网络不能依赖任何一个神经元，只能学出冗余的表示。
The network cannot rely on any single neuron, so it learns redundant representations.
2015 年的归一化：把每层输入的尺度压到 1 附近。
Normalization, 2015: bring each layer's input scale close to one.
训练更稳，也允许更大的学习率。
Training gets steadier, and larger learning rates become usable.
同年 ResNet 的残差连接：输出等于输入加上一个改变量。
ResNet, same year: make the output the input plus a learned change.
反向时，梯度可以沿这个加号直接流回去。
Going backward, the gradient can flow straight through that plus sign.
一百层的网络因此能训练；Transformer 里它是标配。
A hundred-layer network becomes trainable, and Transformers use it everywhere.
这四个里，残差连接是最重要的一个。
Of the four, the residual connection matters most.
最后，纠正一个很常见的误解。
Finally, let's correct a common misunderstanding.
训练不是把知识一条一条写进模型。
Training is not writing knowledge into the model, one fact at a time.
它是在调整一个巨大分布的参数，让训练数据上的意外最小。
It adjusts the parameters of a huge distribution to make the training data least surprising.
知识是这个过程留下的痕迹，不是被显式存储的条目。
Knowledge is the trace this process leaves, not an explicitly stored entry.
所以模型可能记住，而不是理解。
So a model may memorize instead of understand.
训练误差可以一直降，验证误差却会先降后升。
Training error can keep falling, while validation error falls and then rises.
训练集上极好、新数据上崩掉，这叫过拟合。
Great on the training set, broken on new data: that is overfitting.
对抗它的通用手段叫正则化。
The general antidote is called regularization.
dropout、权重衰减、数据增强、早停，都是它的形式。
Dropout, weight decay, data augmentation, early stopping: all its forms.
共同哲学是限制模型的自由，逼它学规律而不是背答案。
Their shared philosophy: limit the model's freedom, force it to learn rules, not answers.
这正是奥卡姆剃刀：如无必要，勿增实体。
This is Occam's razor: do not multiply entities beyond necessity.
这一章，我们有了发动机。
This chapter gave us the engine.
但还有一个空白：词本身怎么变成数字？
But one gap remains: how does a word become a number?
下一章讲表示学习，从 one-hot 到 word2vec。
Next chapter: representation learning, from one-hot to word2vec.
还有那句著名的语言学信条：观其伴，知其义。
And the old linguistic motto: you shall know a word by the company it keeps.
第三章，表示学习。我们下期见。
Chapter three: representation learning. See you next time.
